name: Sun Cleric: Last Call keeps Valkyr's Calling's flight 1 second longer, landing at 3 s instead of 2 s
contract: Last Call 681448 reads 'Increases the duration of Valkyr's Calling by $/1000;s1 sec.' Its effect 0 is
SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, SPELLMOD_DURATION, BasePoints 999 (+1000 ms), on class mask word 2 2097152, the
SpellFamilyFlags[2] of Valkyr's Calling 520024 and of its flight aura 520025 (DurationIndex 39, 2000 ms); no other
family 33 spell modifier reaches that bit. A 520024 cast applies 520025 to the caster and schedules the landing and
the removal of 520025; they followed the unmodified 2000 ms of 520024, so the flight ended at 2 s with the passive
(batch 5a, aura absent at 2730-2790 ms). They now follow the flight aura's own maximum duration. Two level-60 Sun
Clerics cast 520024 at a stationary dummy; game time read before each aura read bounds it from below, and the read
after a 'still up' check bounds it from above. Without Last Call the flight is up before 1950 ms and gone after
2050 ms; with it, it is still up after 2800 ms and gone after 3050 ms (Sun Cleric ADR 0010).
